title: The Wonderful Wizard of Oz
description: A cyclone carries Dorothy and Toto from Kansas to the magical Land of Oz, where they follow the yellow brick road with three unlikely friends in search of courage, wisdom, heart and a way home.
catalogueBlurb: Follow Dorothy and Toto along the yellow brick road to the Emerald City.

cover.alt: W. W. Denslow's original 1900 cover for The Wonderful Wizard of Oz.

editions.label: Story House Edition
editions.author: L. Frank Baum, retold by Quill

text.source: Original Story House retelling based on L. Frank Baum's public-domain 1900 novel
text.notes: The underlying 1900 novel is public domain. This wording is an original child-friendly Unicorn Valley retelling.

illustrations.source: Original 1900 illustrations by W. W. Denslow
illustrations.notes: The selected Denslow source files are identified as public domain on Wikimedia Commons.

rights.curatorNotes: Condensed into ten reader sections preserving the full journey and central characters while softening some of the original novel's more graphic violence.

text.notes: The complete public-domain 1900 novel is retained, including Baum's Introduction, without abridgement or modernisation. Project Gutenberg boilerplate and source-only illustration markers are excluded.

illustrations.notes: The six previously verified W. W. Denslow illustrations are reused beside matching passages in the complete classic text.

edition.notes: Story House pagination changes presentation only; the source wording and all 24 chapters remain complete.

rights.curatorNotes: Baum's Introduction and all 24 chapters reflowed into 101 reader pages at paragraph boundaries, with six historical Denslow illustrations anchored to matching scenes.
